title: RenditionFindingChangedPayload
description: Payload of the RenditionFindingChanged event (class: domain). Coordinator ruling INV-Q-6323 option A, INV-REQ-648: the entity's PAY-014 rendition finding opened (open true) or closed (open false); the finding is the entity's, not a document's. At-least-once delivery; consumers order by sequence, which rises by one step per change of the entity's finding. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41).

entityRef.description: The entity the finding is raised against.

open.description: True while the entity's PAY-014 finding is open.

sequence.description: Per-entity monotonic sequence of finding changes; consumers order by it.
